note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Montana 2025 Regular Session (LegiScan 2159). Seats in these notes come from Montana's own roster of the 69th Legislature (api.legmt.gov), NOT from LegiScan's `district` field: LegiScan still carries the pre-2024-map district for 63 of the 151 members, so its seat disagrees with the state's own record more often than it agrees. Mapped entries are the proposer's 85 matches, each checked against the official seat, plus 2 hand-added members whose working name LegiScan stores only in its `nickname` field. Every unmapped entry carries the reason it is null.
